drawer.helpIntro: Arovia helps you navigate healthcare facilities across Gujarat with verified hospital details and AI symptom guidance.
drawer.aboutIntro: Arovia is an AI-powered healthcare navigator designed for Gujarat, India. Our goal is to make healthcare discovery fast, transparent, and accessible to everyone.
drawer.aboutBullet1: Verified hospitals across all 33 Gujarat districts from Government LGD records.
drawer.aboutBullet2: AI Clinical Urgency assessment with triage recommendations.
drawer.aboutBullet3: Full trilingual support in English, Gujarati (ગુજરાતી), and Hindi (हिन्दी).
drawer.privacyContent:
1. Location Privacy: Arovia accesses GPS location only with your explicit foreground permission to compute distances to nearby hospitals. We never track your location in the background.

2. Medical Data: Any symptoms submitted to the AI Symptom Navigator are used solely for immediate educational triage and are never shared with third-party advertisers.

3. Account Security: Your passwords are encrypted with bcrypt and JWT authentication tokens are stored securely on your device using AsyncStorage.
drawer.termsContent:
1. Educational Healthcare Guidance: Arovia provides informational guidance only. AI triage results do NOT constitute a medical diagnosis or medical advice.

2. Emergencies: In case of life-threatening emergencies, cardiac symptoms, or acute trauma, users must immediately dial 108 or proceed to the nearest emergency room.

3. Hospital Listings: Hospital timings, fee estimates, and bed availability are based on official directories and may vary. Please contact the hospital directly before traveling.

footer.description: India's most trusted platform for finding nearby hospitals and expert healthcare guidance.
